sections.name: AGENT_TRANSLATIONS
sections.title: Unreviewed English translations of quotes
sections.what: A table that maps each non-English source quote to an English reading written by the agent. The text appears in workbooks only, labelled as an agent translation.
sections.why: The header comment states the purpose: fill gaps where no researcher translation exists, without affecting any check.
sections.watch_out: Keys must match the fingerprint exactly. A changed quote or a typo in a key makes the translation disappear with no error.

summary: A fixed lookup table of agent-written English translations for foreign-language source quotes that had no researcher translation.
purpose: Lets workbooks show an English reading of a foreign quote, clearly labelled as an unreviewed agent translation.
why: The header comment says these translations are unreviewed, appear only in workbooks, and are never used by a check, so they cannot change a result.
how: Each entry is keyed by a fingerprint of the quote text. Each entry gives the source language and the English text. The header says the worklist is regenerated by the script list-untranslated-quotes.ts. An entry with empty English text marks a quote the language check misreads as foreign, such as a place name, and needs no translation.
inputs: A fingerprint key for a quote, supplied by the code that builds workbooks. The fingerprint function is named quoteKey in the header but its code is not in this file.
outputs: The language and English text for a matching quote, or nothing when no key matches.
risks: If a quote's text changes, its fingerprint changes and its translation silently stops matching. The translations are machine-written and have not been reviewed.
debug: If a quote shows no translation, check that its fingerprint is in this table. If a translation looks wrong, compare it with the original quote. If entries are missing, rerun the script named in the header.
